Make a Restart Pool From Simulations Run With Scenarios

Source: R/restart_pool.R
make_restart_pool.Rd

Creates a directory of single simulation restart points (1.rds, 2.rds, ...) from the batch files written by netsim_scenarios, step_tmpl_netsim_scenarios or step_tmpl_netsim_swfcalib_output. Such a directory can be passed as path_to_x to these functions (see netsim_path_wrapper).

Usage

make_restart_pool(
  pool_dir,
  scenarios_dir,
  scenario_name,
  keep_sims,
  time_attrs
)

Arguments

pool_dir

Path to the restart pool directory to create. It must not exist.

scenarios_dir

The directory containing the sim__<scenario>__<batch>.rds files.

scenario_name

The name of the scenario to make the pool from.

keep_sims

A data.frame with a batch_number and a sim_number column, one row per simulation to put in the pool. sim_number is the position of the simulation within its batch file (the sim_number column of merge_netsim_scenarios_tibble, not the sim one).

time_attrs

A character vector of the attributes holding time steps, passed to EpiModel::make_restart_point.

Value

The pool index data.frame (invisibly).

Details

Pool element i is made from row i of keep_sims, with EpiModel::make_restart_point (keeping only the last time step). Each batch file is read once, and each element is written to the pool as soon as it is made, so only one batch file's elements are in memory at a time. The pool directory also receives a pool_index.csv file with one row per pool element: pool_num, scenario_name, batch_number, sim_number, file_path (the batch file it was made from) and epimodel_version (the EpiModel version recorded in the element, which netsim requires to have the installed major.minor version to restart from it). A directory is used as a restart pool only if it holds this file.

The pool is written in a hidden .<pool name>.partial directory next to pool_dir, renamed to pool_dir once complete: pool_dir never holds a partial pool, even if R is killed. The partial directory is removed if an error occurs, or at the next call if R was killed.

See also

validate_restart_pool(), netsim_path_wrapper()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
d_sim <- readRDS("data/run/calib/merged_tibbles/df__default.rds")
keep_sims <- dplyr::distinct(d_sim, batch_number, sim_number)[1:32, ]
make_restart_pool(
  pool_dir = "data/run/restart_pool",
  scenarios_dir = "data/run/calib",
  scenario_name = "default",
  keep_sims = keep_sims,
  time_attrs = c("infTime")
)
validate_restart_pool("data/run/restart_pool")
} # }
